## Activity

During June 2026, Central Eye Clinic completed 217 captures. This represents the recorded imaging activity for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below. The activity should continue to be reviewed through routine site operations monitoring, with any recurring operational concerns identified and addressed through the appropriate service arrangements.

## Image quality

There were 3 ungradable captures during the reporting period. The ungradable rate was 1.4 per cent. This measure should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality review, with attention given to recurring camera issues. The clinic lead asks that such issues are logged with the service desk so they can be tracked and followed up through the established process.

## Grading

Grading identified 59 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 2 days. These results provide the monthly overview of grading activity at Central Eye Clinic and should be considered alongside the reported capture volume and image quality measures. Continued recording of operational issues will support review of the service and help maintain clear oversight of activity, image quality and grading performance.
